body:
i dont think we should change anything here. Current mail panel designed to use yii2 official mail extension and it is not supposed to be for everything.
There was a disscusion also that in such issues you can create your own panels if needed.

rename.to: Debug MailPanel cannot be extend in other mail api library

body: why would you need to create own panel? here I want to subclass BaseMessage and BaseMailer, so it means everytime there is Mailer Api Library such as SendGrid I need to create another panel called SendGridPanel? I don't think its right. there is an interface called `MessageInterface` I don't see an issue why it would be a roadblock and the possible solution is to rename `getSwiftMessage()` to `getMessage()` so subclass can override it to whatever mail library they use.

we should not rename it because it actually returns swift mailer message, and this panel is not universal it is only for yii2 extension that provides swift mailer because we need to get headers and other things from message, it was done so by design.
you still don't get it. that's why we have Interface class to match the methods and functions. so you saying that MailPanel can't be used on different Mail Library? that's crazy man!
I don't think simple renaming a functions can hurt the system. it's not restructuring or changing the core. its only renaming the method to more globally so subclass can extend it

thats not crazy, that is so because we cant limit user to provide all requirements for debug mail panel when he subclass from `Message` class, because in this way he will need to create 2 classes instead of 1, and second class should have also base class or interface with all those methods that currently used in debug mail panel.

remember we are not talking about relogic the structure. its all about having a capability to make the system to use different kind of Mail library with proper method naming. so renaming the method won't hurt the core.

do you understand that in your example `getMessage` should return message instance that should contain all methods, including `getHeaders`, `getDate` and other that are used [here](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/extensions/debug/panels/MailPanel.php#L38). With that said we need to have one more base class or interface for this class to make it consistent so everything will work. As i said once again this is a debug mail panel that by design was made to use official yii2 swiftmailer extension, you can create your own panel if needed.

@Ragazzo, BaseMessage and BaseMailer have Interface class. so Subclass naturally have those methods... 

so you saying that every Mail library will get Panel for the debugging? crazy man! you don't even understand the scenario in just simple renaming the problem will solve. all you think is about Swift Mailer. Not everybody is using Swift mailer and remember we are talking about 2 extensions that won't work together. as i said that ext:debug is only an extension.

`BaseMessage` dont have this method (`getHeaders`). And please stop always posting `crazy man`, thanks.
@klimov-paul what is your opinion on this one ? should we add `get/set Headers` to the `MessageInterface` since by default php `mail` function also support them ?

so you agree with me now? the panel is too specific that only capable to SwiftMailer and not capable to being re-used in different library. it should be flexible enough as long as we are extending the `BaseMessage` and `BaseMailer` and the panel should work fine

> I don't have a method called getSwiftMessage() I think it should be rename to getMessage() and subclass will override the it.

Originally this method was named "getVendorMessage()", but then has been renamed to sound more specific. However its renaming will NOT solve the issue. While implementing `MessageInterface` you may need no such method at all.

I can see several possible solutions here:

1) Introduce another method inside the `BaseMessage` or even `MessageInterface` called `toArray()`, which should return the message representation as array. Then mail panel may use this method to compose row data.

2) We can add an "if" statement to the mail panel processing: if Message is instance of "swiftmailer/Message" use current implementation, if not - use only methods defined by `MessageInterface`, filling other keys with "unknown" or simply skip them.
:+1:  to toArray(). they are more flexible so the subclass can put any kind of data with key value pair in the array.
as for me second one is better, since toArray does not makes a lot of sence since we can iterate over public properties in php by default.
in conclusion. 1 or 2 works fine on me.. as long as the MailPanel doesn't bind to use only `getSwiftMessage()`
we can also use `__toString()` in BaseMessage class to be used in MailPanel? instead of adding IF or introducing another method

> we can also use __toString() in BaseMessage class to be used in MailPanel?

As far as I understand: array is used to compose a grid, which allows sorting. Single string representation will not suffice. But this can be used as an alternative in case message is not from Swift.

okay. 1 more concern sendgrid is sending this response

for error message

``` json
{ errors: ["Missing something"], message: "error" }
```

for success message

``` json
{ message: "success" }
```

it would be good if we can add the raw response in the MailPanel. so now I strongly suggest that we should use `toArray()` or anything configurable by the subclass

$message = $event->message->getSwiftMessage();

But I think name of method "getSwiftMessage" is not good for common extension
